data.exact_reserve_text: An overall release of prior year's provisions for claims during the year of approximately GBP 19.0m (2015: release of GBP 37.6m) was primarily driven by the favourable experience on the Marine accounts in Aviation and Marine of GBP 26.5m (2015: release of GBP 54.7m), and Property and Fire release of GBP 0.5m (2015: release of GBP 5.3m). This is offset by the adverse experience on the Public Liability accounts in Third Party Liability of GBP 11.0m (2015: strengthening of GBP 23.4m).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Favourable development on marine/aviation accounts resulting in a release of GBP 26.5m of prior year provisions.

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse experience on Public Liability (Third Party Liability)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse development on Third Party Liability resulting in a strengthening of GBP 11.0m of prior year provisions.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports an overall release of prior-year claims provisions of approximately GBP 19.0m in 2016 (around -3.4% of opening gross claims outstanding GBP 559.6m). The release was driven mainly by favourable development in the Marine/Aviation portfolios (release of GBP 26.5m) and a small release in Property/Fire (GBP 0.5m), partly offset by adverse development in Third Party Liability (GBP 11.0m).

This is offset by the adverse experience on the Public Liability accounts in Third Party Liability of GBP 11.0m (2015: strengthening of GBP 23.4m).

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding 2015 column = GBP 559,601k). Prior-year development taken from note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which explicitly states a release of GBP 19.0m (treated as gross). Some segmental gross premium written cells are negative (shown in report) and one class showed a dash which has been treated as 0. The claims development triangle was transcribed from the printed table but some cell alignments were inferred from the image; see _claims_triangle confidence.
